params.text: Maktabati design tokens — single source of truth: docs/04-ux-design.md §5–§7, shipped as src/app.css
Four elevations and two border weights, in every theme.
Six presets, each with accent / soft / soft-ink. Applied to buttons, links, focus rings, progress bars, active nav and the heatmap ramp.
Accent-independent status colours, each with a soft companion.
1.200 minor third on a 16px base. Arabic gets the looser --lh-read (1.85) so diacritics and descenders never collide.
A four-step radius ramp on an 8px rhythm (4/8/12/16/24/32/48/64).
The base kit: buttons, field, chip, progress, rating, stat card.
